title: Placing appliances and equipment in operation.
officialText: Gas utilization appliances and equipment shall be permitted to be placed in operation after the piping system has been checked for leakage in accordance with Section 406.6.3 and determined to be free of leakage and purged in accordance with Section 406.7.2.
